subject: Obstruction - Strait of Georgia
text:
Obstruction - Strait of Georgia
A partially submerged vessel has been reported mid channel between Gibsons marina and Keats Island, in the vicinity of 49 23.800N 123 29.667W. The 14ft Aluminum Skiff is in the vertical position, with the bow showing 5ft out of the water. 
Caution.
